before: spl_autoload_register accepts a callable invoked when PHP needs an undefined class. It does not implement dependency installation. The loader must map trusted class names to intended files.

This tiny loader recognizes only Topic and requires the fixed Topic.php path. Save that file beside main.php with the class shown below. It never constructs a path from unchecked request text. Real package autoloaders can organize larger mappings, but none is downloaded here.
```php
<?php
class Topic { public function label(): string { return "loaded"; } }
```
Expected output or behavior: loaded. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
Optional local transfer task: Explain why namespace use and class autoloading are separate operations. You may trace it without a PHP interpreter; reading completion is not proof of a local run.

Tell PHP which function can find a missing class file.
The output is `loaded`. Requesting Topic makes the loader read Topic.php. The class method then returns loaded.
